subject.title: [Bug]: Hallucination Loop — Agent Generated Irrelevant Multi-Thousand-Word Responses Across 2 Simultaneous Sessions

question: Should this incident be treated as expected shared-DM configuration behavior, a Telegram/session-routing bug, a delivery/reconnect recovery bug, or a new semantic runaway-output guard requirement?
rationale: The evidence proves a real Telegram send burst on a config without session.dmScope, but the payload-free export and current defaults do not identify which product boundary should own the fix.

options.title: Keep Open For Boundary Triage
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide which boundary owns the incident and what additional reproduction or diagnostic evidence is required.

options.title: Close As Config/Support
options.body: Close only if maintainers intentionally accept shared DM main-session behavior here and document the supported per-channel-peer remediation path as sufficient.

options.title: Sponsor A Focused Fix
options.body: Open or assign a focused fix after choosing one boundary, such as doctor guidance for missing dmScope, Telegram routing proof, reconnect-drain repair, or semantic loop protection.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Boundary Triage
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide which boundary owns the incident and what additional reproduction or diagnostic evidence is required.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses product scope, route-aware reply dedupe, and safety policy; steipete has adjacent route-dedupe history and is the strongest sampled owner for the boundary decision.
